contentList.content: Sorcery Points are an important facet of a Sorcerer's power. They can be spent to augment Spells in unique and powerful ways, or converted to be used as fuel for Spell Slots. You may have up to 24 Sorcery Points at any given time.
Sorcery Points can be used to augment Spells in unique and powerful ways. You may have up to 24 Sorcery Points at any given time.

Gain the ability to, while in combat, convert Spell Slots into Sorcery Points and vice versa.

When converting Sorcery Points into Spell Slots, you may create Spell Slots up to one level higher than what you can normally cast, up to the sixth level. You cannot create more than twice the amount of Spell Slots that you would normally have available for any given level.

Additionally, when another creature expends a Spell Slot in order to cast a Spell within [1] of you, you may store the arcane energy, immediately creating a Sorcery Point.

At the end of combat, all created Sorcery Points and Spell Slots are removed.

When a creature expends a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> within [1] of you in combat, you may store the arcane energy, immediately creating a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Point</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

Affected creature is storing residual arcane energy. They will create three <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Points</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter upon reaching three stacks of Sorcerous Overflow.

Exchange 2 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Points</LSTag> in order to gain a level two <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

Exchange 3 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Points</LSTag> in order to gain a level three <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

Exchange 4 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Points</LSTag> in order to gain a level four <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

Exchange 5 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Points</LSTag> in order to gain a level five <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

Exchange 6 <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Points</LSTag> in order to gain a level six <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slot</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

The maximum amount of Spell Slots you may create is equal to two times your normal limit within each Spell level. You may create up to one Spell level higher than what would otherwise be your natural limit.

While in combat, you gain one Sorcery Point per turn.

At the end of combat, all created Sorcery Points and Spell Slots are removed.
On your first turn of any combat encounter, gain <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Points</LSTag> equal to your level.

Hematic Monarchs wield blood as both weapon and birthright. Their art is said to descend from Kiku, Vampiric Lord of Terror, who once taught that agony and rapture are but two pulses of the same beating heart.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

Gain <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_Bloodborne">Bloodborne</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HematicWithdrawal">Hematic Withdrawal</LSTag>, and <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Zone_PiercingBlood">Piercing Blood</LSTag>.

Coat your weapons in blood, increasing the physical damage they deal by [1] and utilizing your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbilityModifier">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage.

Coat your melee weapons in blood, increasing the physical damage they deal by [1] and utilizing your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbilityModifier">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage.

Coat your ranged weapons in blood, increasing the physical damage they deal by [1] and utilizing your <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbilityModifier">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage.

Affected weapon has become magical, increasing the physical damage it deals by [1] and utilizing its owners <LSTag Tooltip="SpellcastingAbilityModifier">Spellcasting Ability</LSTag> for <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage.

Rend the blood from your targets flesh, causing them to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING">Bleed</LSTag>. If they are capable of Bleeding, you restore your own <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> equal to the damage dealt.

Compress and condense your blood to the edge of your fingertips in order to fire a viciously fast beam of blood which leaves your targets with <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="GAPING_WOUND">Gaping Wounds</LSTag>.
Dealing damage forces your target to become an <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING_EFFIGY">Effigy of Blood</LSTag>. Only one creature may become an Effigy of Blood at a time.

Affected creature loses 10% of their total <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> at the start of each turn and has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Constitution based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

When casting Spells, you may expend your own <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> in place of <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">Spell Slots</LSTag>, expending 5% of your total Hit Points per level of Spell Slot spent. This can be toggled at any time.
At the start of each of your turns, bolts of blood rain from the sky across a [1] area, dealing damage to any nearby enemies. This can be toggled at any time.

While in combat, you become an <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLEEDING_IDOL">Idol of the Bloodletter</LSTag>, causing you to recover 10% of your total <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> each turn and roll Constitution based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

Affected creature recovers 10% of their total <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> each turn, and rolls all Constitution based <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

Focus your thoughts on the blood churning in those around you, in order to tear it from their flesh. Float to the sky, and for three turns, each enemy within [1] of you erupts in blood, halving their <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> and taking [2] at the beginning of each of their turns.

Affected creature is forcibly tearing the blood from all nearby creatures. For three turns, each enemy within [1] of them erupts in blood, halving their <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> and taking [2] at the beginning of each of their turns.
Affected creature is having the blood forcibly torn from it's body. It's <LSTag Tooltip="MovementSpeed">Movement Speed</LSTag> is halved, and it takes [1] at the beginning of each of their turns.

Power flows visibly through you in cascading waves of illuminated brilliance. Radiant and pure, yet effortlessly frightening to those who behold it. A reincarnation of the "Ever Brilliant Mako".

Suggested Role(s): Healer/Support

While in combat, casting a Spell causes you to emit an aura across [1]. The duration of this aura is equal to the level of Spell that you cast. Allies within the aura regain [2] <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> at the start of their turns. Enemies within the aura take [3] at the start of their turns.

Affected creature is emitting an aura across [1]. Allies within the aura regain [2] <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> at the start of their turns. Enemies within the aura take [3] at the start of their turns.
Affected creature will regain [1] <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> at the start of each turn due to a nearby allies radiance.
Affected creature will take [1] Radiant damage at the start of each turn due to a nearby enemies radiance.

Unleash your radiance in a [1] area, damaging enemies and healing allies for [2] Hit Points.

Casting this Spell will grant an additional turn of Soulfire Spark per creature you target.

Your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="SoulfireSpark">Soulfire Spark</LSTag> has been upgrade to a Soulfire Ignition. Allies within the aura now regain [1] <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag> at the start of their turns. Enemies within the aura now take [2] at the start of their turns.

Allies within the radius of your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="SoulfireIgnition">Soulfire Ignition</LSTag> deal an additional [1] with their weapons. In addition, each time that you deal Radiant damage to an enemy, your target is afflicted with one <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_RADIANT_RADIATING_ORB">Radiating Orb</LSTag>.
The healing done and damage dealt to creatures within your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="SoulfireIgnition">Soulfire Ignition</LSTag> now triggers at both the start and end of their turns.

Unleash your inner radiance in a [1] area, damaging enemies and healing allies within your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="SoulfireIgnition">Soulfire Ignition</LSTag> for [2] <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>.

You siphon your powers from the Shadowfell itself, the light in your soul snuffed out by an unsettling darkness.

Suggested Role(s): Damage/Summoner

Gain the ability to create clouds of Darkness as a Bonus Action, as well as the ability to summon a Hound of Ill Omen. Your Hound is capable of cloning itself upon being hit, and grows in strength alongside you as you level.

In addition, you gain the ability to see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of [1].
Summon forth a hound of darkness.

Gain the ability to absorb the life force of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoundOfIllOmen">Hounds of Ill Omen</LSTag> and other summons. When your Hounds land a killing blow, you generate one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Point</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

Upon landing a killing blow, the Sorcerer who conjured this Hound generates one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Point</LSTag> until the end of their current combat encounter.

Siphon the very soul from one of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoundOfIllOmen">Hounds of Ill Omen</LSTag> or other summons, killing them instantly and causing a necrotic explosion which deals [1] to all enemies in a [2] radius. You may also siphon other creature's summons as well. Upon siphoning a creature, you recover +1d12 <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>.

As a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoundOfIllOmen">Hound of Ill Omen</LSTag>, you may be absorbed in order to restore your Sorcerer's <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>. Upon being absorbed, a necrotic explosion occurs, dealing [1] to all enemies in a [2] radius.

As a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoundOfIllOmen">Hound of Ill Omen</LSTag>, you may be absorbed in order to restore your Sorcerer's <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>. Upon being absorbed, a necrotic explosion occurs, dealing [1] to all enemies in a [2] radius.

Affected creature is affected by an Ill Omen. Upon dying, the Sorcerer who's Hound applied this condition will generate one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Point</LSTag> until the end of their current combat encounter.
Affected creature is just the worst kind of person!

You may now summon two <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoundOfIllOmen">Hounds of Ill Omen</LSTag> at once. Your Hounds may now cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_UmbralWarp">Umbral Warp</LSTag> as a free action, and have also gained an <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="ExtraAttack">Extra Action</LSTag>.
Warp to an unoccupied, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING_HEAVILY_OBSCURED">Heavily Obscured</LSTag> space.

Gain the ability to warp to an unoccupied, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING_HEAVILY_OBSCURED">Heavily Obscured</LSTag> location within [1] of you as a free action using <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_UmbralWarp">Umbral Warp</LSTag>. Your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoundOfIllOmen">Hounds of Ill Omen</LSTag> now create pockets of Darkness upon dying.
Upon dying, create a pocket of Darkness.

You may now summon three <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoundOfIllOmen">Hounds of Ill Omen</LSTag> at once. Your Hounds may now cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_HowloftheDamned">Howl of the Damned</LSTag> along with <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_UmbralWarp">Umbral Warp</LSTag>, and have gain an additional <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">Action</LSTag>.
Howl, summoning shadow vines which potentially <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="UMBRA_ENTANGLED">Entangle</LSTag> nearby enemies.

While <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SNEAKING_HEAVILY_OBSCURED">Heavily Obscured</LSTag>, all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> and damage rolls you make are rolled with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>. When your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_HoundOfIllOmen">Hounds of Ill Omen</LSTag> clone themselves, their clones last until the end of combat, and can now produce further clones of their own as well.

Within your blood rages an endless winter. Those touched by your frozen power are driven into a maddened frenzy beneath the tundra's merciless chill.

Suggested Role(s): Control/Damage
When dealing damage to an enemy, you deal additional Cold damage equal to your levels in Sorcerer. This bonus does not apply to damage dealt with an off-hand weapon.
Dealing damage has a chance to apply one turn of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MADNESS">Madness</LSTag> to your target.

Once per turn, upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag> against a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MADNESS">Maddened</LSTag> enemy, you generate one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Point</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

Enemies suffering from <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MADNESS">Madness</LSTag> receive [1] per turn. In addition, when dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore Cold based <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag>.

<LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MADNESS">Maddened</LSTag> enemies deal the maximum damage possible when targeting their allies. In addition, Maddened enemies are considered to be priority targets, and are significantly more likely to be targeted by their allies.
Once per turn, upon using <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="Tooltip_CreationaryText">Creationary</LSTag>, all enemies within of you [1] take [2].

Searing heat broils within you, an ancient and irrevocable flame as unpredictable as it is uncontrollable.

Suggested Role(s): Damage

When dealing damage to an enemy or item, you ignore Fire based <LSTag Tooltip="Resistant">Resistance</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immunity</LSTag>. At the start of each of your turns, and upon landing a killing blow or <LSTag Tooltip="CriticalHit">Critical Hit</LSTag>, you generate one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FIRE_HEAT">Heat</LSTag>.

When an ally is about to be damaged, you may expend one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FIRE_HEAT">Heat</LSTag> in order to fire a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_PyrrhicFlare">Pyrrhic Flare</LSTag> at their aggressor. In addition, killing a <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING">Burning</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BURNING_LAVA">Melting</LSTag> enemy will generate one <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="SorceryPoint">Sorcery Point</LSTag> until the end of your current combat encounter.

When an ally is about to be damaged, expend one stack of <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="MAG_FIRE_HEAT">Heat</LSTag> in order to fire a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_PyrrhicFlare">Pyrrhic Flare</LSTag> at their aggressor.
A flare so hot that upon landing, one might confuse the result with a small area of magma.

You gain Immunity to Fire damage. Upon dealing Fire damage while you possess stacks of Heat, you fire a Flickering Pyrrhic Flare at another enemy within [1] of your target.

Each Flickering Pyrrhic Flare fired will reduce your Heat stacks by 1, and each enemy may only be targeted by a Flickering Pyrrhic Flare if they are not Burning or Melting. The damage of Flickering Pyrrhic Flares cannot be increased. This can be toggled at any time.
A flickering flare, still exceptionally hot to the touch.
Once per combat encounter, you may immediately erupt, creating a [1] pool of lava beneath the feet of all enemies within [2] of you.
